findings.title: IOCTL handlers missing InputBufferLength validation
findings.description: The following IOCTL handlers do not appear to validate InputBufferLength before processing the buffer: 0x80000005. Without size checks, a short buffer could cause pool overread or out-of-bounds writes.

findings.title: IoCreateDevice without FILE_DEVICE_SECURE_OPEN
findings.description: Driver uses IoCreateDevice instead of IoCreateDeviceSecure and FILE_DEVICE_SECURE_OPEN flag was not detected. Without this flag, the device object inherits permissive default security, allowing any user to open a handle. Use IoCreateDeviceSecure with an SDDL string to restrict access.

findings.title: ROP/JOP gadgets found: 776 total (misc: 220, reg-control: 208, memory-read: 138, memory-write: 132, stack-pivot: 60, jmp-reg: 18)
findings.description:
Found 776 usable ROP/JOP gadgets in executable sections. Since many drivers lack ASLR, these gadgets are at predictable addresses and can be chained for kernel exploitation.

Top gadgets by type:
  [stack-pivot] (60 found):
    0x180001449: xchg esp, eax ; ret
    0x180001447: or byte ptr [rdi], cl ; xchg esp, eax ; ret
    0x180001444: xchg dword ptr [rax + 0x39], ecx ; or byte ptr [rdi], cl ; xchg esp, eax ; ret
  [memory-write] (132 found):
    0x180002B60: mov dword ptr [rcx + 8], edx ; ret
    0x180002B5F: mov qword ptr [rcx + 8], rdx ; ret
    0x180002B5C: mov dword ptr [rcx + 2], eax ; mov qword ptr [rcx + 8], rdx ; ret
  [memory-read] (138 found):
    0x1800013C8: mov esi, dword ptr [rsp + 0x168] ; add rsp, 0x140 ; pop rbp ; ret
    0x1800013C7: mov rsi, qword ptr [rsp + 0x168] ; add rsp, 0x140 ; pop rbp ; ret
    0x1800013C5: add byte ptr [rax], al ; mov rsi, qword ptr [rsp + 0x168] ; add rsp, 0x140 ; pop rbp ; ret
  [reg-control] (208 found):
    0x1800013D6: pop rbp ; ret
    0x1800013D4: add byte ptr [rax], al ; pop rbp ; ret
    0x1800013D0: add esp, 0x140 ; pop rbp ; ret
  [jmp-reg] (18 found):
    0x18000178B: add ecx, edx ; jmp rcx
    0x18000178A: add rcx, rdx ; jmp rcx
    0x180001788: add byte ptr [rax], al ; add rcx, rdx ; jmp rcx
